name: Mateusz Gamrot

face.shape: Long, rectangular face, a little longer than it is wide, with defined cheekbones, flat cheeks and a squared lower face under the beard. Lean, with no soft tissue under the jaw. The back of the head is rounded in the 2026 profile.
face.jaw: Strong and angular. The jaw angles sit well out under the ears, and the short beard follows the bone, so the lower face reads square.
face.chin: Moderately broad and square, projecting slightly. In 2015, with only a thin chin-strap beard, the chin sits a little forward of the lower-lip line.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high and well defined. The cheeks below are flat to slightly hollow at fight weight.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate. The brows sit low over the eyes, but the ridge is not heavy.
face.forehead: Broad and medium-tall, with two or three horizontal creases that deepen when he raises his brows (Rio 2025, UFC 299). The hairline runs straight across, with slight recession at the temple corners.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped, medium size, with slightly hooded upper lids and a little fullness under the lower lids. Outer corners level.
eyes.spacing: Average, about one eye width apart.
eyes.colour: Dark brown (studio headshot, Rio 2025, 2015 weigh-in). Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Low and fairly straight, rising gently toward the outer third. The inner ends lift when he raises his brows, which gives a slightly worried look in several photos (Rio 2025, UFC 327 post-fight).
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown, close to the hair colour.

nose.width: Medium. The bridge is fairly narrow and widens to a rounded tip.
nose.hump: None visible; the profile is straight (UFC 327 face-off).
nose.tip: Rounded, slightly bulbous, pointing a little down.
nose.fight_damage: No obvious deformity. Tape across the bridge at the August 2026 media day points to a recent cut or knock; do not model it.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, partly covered by the moustache.
mouth.resting_expression: Lips closed, corners level. He often smiles widely, showing straight upper teeth (2025 studio cutout, 2015 weigh-in).

ears.protrusion: Stand out moderately and are very visible with the buzz cut.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, both ears. The upper ear (helix, antihelix and the bowl) is thickened and lumpy, worst on the LEFT ear (studio headshot); the right ear also shows a swollen upper bowl in the UFC 327 profile. Commons files the 2015 photo under 'Sportspeople with cauliflower ears'.
ears.notes: The thickening is the main ear cue; give both ears extra depth and a less defined inner fold.

face.notable_marks_scars: A raised dark-brown mole on his RIGHT cheek, below the eye and beside the nose, seen in the 2015 weigh-in, the 2025 and 2026 studio photos and faintly in the Rio 2025 frame. It is a strong recognition cue. There is also a smaller faint spot under the outer corner of the left eye. Fine forehead creases. No large scars visible.

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, about 1 cm on top, faded shorter on the sides and back (UFC 327 profile). No part and no styling. In 2015 (KSW) he wore shaved sides with a short strip on top and a shaved line; that look is gone.
hair.colour: Dark brown. The scalp shows through, so from a distance the head reads mid-brown.
hair.hairline: Straight front line with slight recession at the temple corners. Full density on top; no crown thinning visible.

facial_hair.colour: Dark brown with a warm tint. A few lighter ginger and grey hairs show around the chin and the corners of the mouth (studio headshot).
facial_hair.density: Dense over the chin, moustache and jaw line; the upper cheek area fills in less.
facial_hair.length_notes: 6-10 mm in 2024-2026 (UFC 299, UFC 327, Vegas 120 and the studio photos); a thin chin strap in 2015.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard joined to the moustache. The cheek line is natural and fairly low, the neckline is trimmed just under the jaw, and the chin is squared off.

skin.excluded_samples: Foreheads in the studio headshot (#f7b693) and at Vegas 120 (#e3b6b2) hit specular highlights.
skin.undertone: Warm, light-medium. The face and neck are more tanned and redder than the torso; the chest in the 2015 photo is clearly lighter.
skin.freckles_marks: The right-cheek mole (see face). Light brown chest hair and a line of hair below the navel, light hair on the forearms and shins.

body.build: Compact, lean and athletic: a wrestler's frame with proportional limbs (70 in reach, equal to his 70 in height).
body.body_fat_notes: Visible abs and oblique lines and a defined chest in the 2025-2026 studio cutouts. Very lean at fight weight.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad with well-rounded delts; moderate traps.
body.chest: Moderately developed, fairly flat pecs with light hair; not bulky.
body.arms: Lean, defined upper arms and strong forearms with visible veins. Arm length is proportional, not long.
body.waist: Narrow and flat with clear ab definition.
body.legs_calves: Lean, muscular thighs and defined calves; leg length proportional to his height.
body.neck: Moderately thick and muscular, of average length.
body.posture: Upright, with the head carried slightly forward. In the studio cutouts his arms hang a little away from the torso, elbows softly bent, gloves at hip height and loosely closed. Fights southpaw (right foot forward). In weigh-in face-offs he holds both fists up near the chin with his elbows tucked (KSW 2015).
body.notable_physique_traits: Very lean, evenly developed physique with no single dominant body part. The silhouette is compact and square-shouldered rather than tall or rangy.

tattoos.description: None visible in any photo from 2015 to August 2026, including both full-body studio cutouts (front and three-quarter).

accessories_seen: Thin gold chain with a small cross pendant (2015); a thin chain at the August 2026 media day.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC-issued black and charcoal shorts with a grey and white slash (tiger-stripe) print (2025-2026 studio). Black waistband panel with a white UFC wordmark at the front. crypto.com logo on his RIGHT thigh; a red vertical 'GAMROT' wordmark on his LEFT thigh.
kit.gloves: Standard black UFC studio gloves; corner-coloured cuffs on fight night.
kit.brand_note: No apparel brand is legible on the shorts; describe them as UFC-issued.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: Ear targets are not in mh-manifest.json but are in assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz; avatar3d.js reads this block. scale-depth stands in for the cauliflower thickening, more on the left ear.

render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow010 (the fuller of the two), tinted #3a271d, set low and nearly straight
render_hints.hair: strand shell buzz cut about 1 cm, faded on the sides and back, tinted #3b2a1f; no hair mesh
render_hints.beard: short full beard 6-10 mm, colour #4f3326, joined moustache, trimmed neckline under the jaw
render_hints.marks: small raised dark-brown mole on the RIGHT cheek beside the nose (#6b4334 approx.); the single most useful facial mark

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin, ears, the mole and build; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 10 photos (2 Commons CC BY 3.0 from 2015, 8 reference-only, 6 of them from 2025-2026), so recent coverage is good, including a real right-side profile (UFC 327 weigh-in). No usable left profile. What to watch: (1) The cauliflower ears and the right-cheek mole are the most distinctive small details; keep both. (2) The buzz cut must read as a shell over a visible scalp, not a hair mesh. (3) Face is long and lean with flat cheeks; default MakeHuman cheeks are too full. (4) No tattoos at all; do not inherit tattoo marks from any generic fighter preset. (5) He fights southpaw: lead with the right foot and right hand. (6) Arms are proportional (reach equals height), unlike most lightweights in the set; do not stretch them. Macro values: ageOldM uses avatar3d.js's (age-25)/65 mapping (age 35, turning 36 on 2026-12-11). heightUpM 0.05 is a guess for 177.8 cm; scale the final mesh to the official height. MakeHuman l-/r- morphs refer to the character's own left and right.
